method: nested CV: hyperparameters chosen by LOO inside TRAIN stations, scored on held-out TEST stations predicted from TRAIN references only
headline: On broadcast SPP receiver clocks -- the real-time / single-frequency user regime -- a distance kernel whose correlation length is SELECTED on held-out data (median lambda* = 4200 km) predicts an unseen station's clock 42% better than no network and 39% better than a bulk network average (wins 100% of splits; across 7 seeds the median skill ranges +40% to +44%). On precise post-processed clocks the effect is absent (-2% skill) -- satellite-side errors have been removed and receiver oscillators are independent.
